tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bshad pa'i rgyud khri drug stong pa'i dgongs pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi las byang bdud

bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gsang ye shes/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed nag po gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi snying po 'khrul 'khor rin po che'i rgyal mtshan 'phrul gyi me long khri drug stong pa zhes bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i le'u brgyad brgya lnga bcu nga bdun pa nas brgyad brgya go lnga'i bar gsungs pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i las byang bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// stong nyid chos dbyings 'gyur bral las/ /rnam rol rdo rje'i khro bo cher// gus btud de nyid sgrub pa'i thabs// rgyud don ji bzhin 'dir bshad do// de la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sngon 'gro ni/ gnas dang sgrub pa yo byad dang*| |skyabs sems bka' bsgo mtshams gcod dang*// byin dbab dam bca' tshogs bsags pa'o// dang po rgyud kyi le'u brgyad brgya don gnyis par/ dur khrod nag stong mtshan ma gcig /chu 'gram shing gcig ri yi rtse// grong khyer lha khang ma mo'i khyim// khang stong bzhi mdo 'thab mo'i gnas// byin che bkra shis dben gnas su// zhes pa rnams gang yang rung bar ro// gnyis pa sgrub po dus gang la ji ltar zhugs pa ni/ de nyid las/ shin tu mnyam bzhag sngags pa yis// 'byung ba'i tshes ni bcu bzhi la// mtshan mo yar phyed mar phyed la// gcer bu skra bsil thal chen dang*// rnam par snang mdzad tshil chen gyis| |lus byug khrag chen thig le gdab// bdud rtsi rnam lnga sha chen bza'// cang te'u dkrol zhing dur khrod kyi// gnas su ha hā zhes su brjod// gar stabs bya zhing sngags bzlas bsgom// zhes pa ltar sgrub gnas su 'gro/ gsum pa yo byad ni/ de nyid las/ ce spyang stag dom gcan gzan tshogs// ro la 'grad cing bya rog khwa// kaṃ ka 'ug pa sha za khri// rnal 'byor gcer bu sgrub pa po// skra bshig phyag rgya lnga dang ldan| |thod pas mgul brgyan ha hā rgod// thod pa cang te'u kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin// bcom ldan khro la rtse gcig blta// dur khrod gnas der 'jug pa bri// gzhan gyis mi mthong rab gnas bya'o// dkyil 'khor rdzas kyis lho phyogs bkram// gzhan yang zhing chen zhing chung gi// 'phan ring 'phan phran rgyu zhags dang*// mi rkang gling bu thod pa'i rnga// dur khrod keng rus rdzas rnams bkram// khro rgyal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi// dam rdzas mchod rdzas rgyan rdzas yin// zhes pa ltar dang*/

gzhan yang mchod gtor bra nag gi 'bru lta bu 'khor gru gsum bcu la ong skyus bskor ba dkar dmar gyis brgyan pa dang*/ sman raka phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas tshogs par bsham/ bris sku lho nas byang du phyogs par bkram pa'i mdun du/ sgrub po byang nas lhor gdong phyogs pas stan bde bar bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga dang ldan pas dur khrod kyi chas dang ldan par 'dug go// bzhi pa skyabs sems ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dam chos dang*// tshogs mchog rnams la bdag skyabs mchi// yon tan rgya mtsho khyod rnams la// bdag gi lus ni dbul bar bgyi// sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir// byang chub sems dag bdag gis bskyed// gang gis bsod nams nyer bsags rnams// rdzogs pa'i byang chub bdag gis bsngo// 'gro 'di kun la phan mdzad phyir// dpal ldan gshin rje mthar byed gyur// ces gsum brjod/ lnga pa bka' bsgo ba ni/ bgegs kyi gtor mar chu chang bran/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭī bi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ byin rlabs spyi ltar byas la sbyin/ hūm̐ */ ma rig nyon mongs las dbang gis// nag po gdug pa srid gsum bdud| |bsgral zhing log rtog rnams sbyang phyir// sangs rgyas thams cad khro bo mdzad// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed por snang*// nga ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// ye shes yin te thugs la gnas// nga ni dus gsum mngon pa'i lha// nga ni bde gshegs kun gyi thugs// nga ni khro rgyal kun gyi rje// nga ni nyon mongs bdud 'dul dpal// ye shes sku nyid rang byung ba// 'dul dka' drag po 'dul ba'i phyir// khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed por mdzad// gnod byed dam sri bgegs log 'dren// bar gcod log lta 'byung po rnams| |mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di khyer la// gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na// skad cig nyid la nyams par bgyi'o// oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭī bi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/

gnod byed dam sri bgegs rigs 'byung po uts+tsha ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa hūm̐ bzhi sngags kyis bskrad/ drug pa mtshams gcod srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐ */ mkha' dkyil nyi shar gdal ba bzhin| |bdag nyid gshed chen gar gyi sku// thugs kyi snying po ring du bskul// 'od zer las byung 'bar ba'i sku// snang srid bde 'chang de bzhin nyid// sprin bral rngam sgra phyogs bcur g.yo| |de bskul me ri mtshon char 'khrigs// khro bo 'bar bcas gtum rngam gtams// steng yang rdo rje'i gur khang la// gur nang rdo rje'i bla bre bris// 'og kyang rdo rje'i sa gzhi la// phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i ra gur 'bar// bar mtshams rdo rje mda'i dra ba// phyi rol ye shes me 'od 'phro// log 'dren dam sri rdul du rlog /bskrad cing bar mtshams phyogs bcur srung*// chos rnams stong zhing rtog dang bral// dmigs med rang byung byang chub sems// mkha' ltar mnyam pa chos kyi dbyings// skye 'gag bral ba'i ngang nyid las// yod pa ma yin med pa min// stong pa nyid las cho 'phrul byung*// de nyid ye shes rol pa'i dbyings// sems nyid ngang las g.yo ba med// sems nyid rol pa snang ba yang*// sprin dang 'ja' tshon khug rlangs bzhin// ye shes sgyu ma'i rang bzhin las// dngos po skye ba nyid kyis stong*// chos rnams thams cad thig ler 'dus// thig le rol pa'i byin rlabs las// sems kyi rang bzhin brtan thob nas// ye shes phyag rgya drod la dbab// bgegs dang log 'dren ming yang med// mtshams gcod srung 'khor gdod nas grub// oṃ ya mān+ta ka badz+ra rak+ṣa ma hā ti la ka dz+nyā na tsakra warti e hūm̐ bh+rūṃ/ zhes brjod/ bdun pa mchod pa rnams byin brlab cing byin dbab pa ni/ sha chen gu gul dang sbyar ba'i spos sreg /rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ hūm̐ */ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i dbyings nyid na// bcom ldan rdo rje khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas| |rgyal ba sras bcas srung ma dam tshig can// mkha' 'gro bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal mchod// bdag ni rgyal srid mtho ris longs spyod dang*// 'dod pa'i yon tan sgrub pa ma lags te// 'gro la snying brtses sangs rgyas bstan pa srung*// bstan pa 'jig byed sgrol bar don brtson pa// ye shes sgrib med khyed kyis sa ler mkhyen// bcom ldan 'jam dpal khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed// tshe rabs sngon nas smon lam 'brel ba'i lha// sngon gyi thugs dam rnal 'byor bdag dang gcig

/sngon tshe lha mchog khyod nyid bsnyen zhing bsgrubs// da ltar rtse gcig bdag gi yi dam lha// thugs dam 'brel ba'i lha mchog bdag bsgrub na// thugs rje rtse gcig rgyun gyis bdag la dgongs// bdag lus dum bu stong du gtub gyur kyang*// yi dam lha mchog khyod nyid gtan mi gtong*// mi srid srid pa'i dgra dang bgegs byung na// khro rgyal mthu chen khyod kyis mthu stsol cig /bcom ldan dbang chen khyod kyis dbang skur cig /thugs rjes bdud 'dul gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha// khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed ni 'dir gshegs shig /gshegs nas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// dus kyi bskal pa me chu rlung 'khrugs kyang*// khyod nyid gcig pus thams cad zhi bar mdzod// nad mtshon mu ge'i bskal pa 'jig mdzad pa// gshin rje'i gshed chen khro rgyal 'dir gshegs la// thugs rje'i zhal bzang bdag la bstan du gsol// dkon mchog spong zhing dam tshig 'bral med pa// thal bar rlogs shig khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed// oṃ āḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe| nai wi d+ye/ shapad pra tīts+tsha ma hā kro dha dz+nyā na ā we sha ya a a aḥ oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ oṃ ma hā ba ling+ta te dz+wa ba ling+ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ oṃ sarba pū dza ma hā kro dha dz+nyā na ā we sha ya a a aḥ zhes sngags rnams lan gsum brjod/ brgyad pa dam bca' ba ni/ hoḥ bcom ldan dpal chen khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed// tshe rabs sngon nas las dang thugs rje dang*// smon lam rgyun gyis rnal 'byor bdag dang 'brel// thugs dam 'brel ba'i lha mchog gshin rje'i gshed// srog la bab kyang lha mchog khyod mi gtong*// thugs rje rtse gcig rgyun gyis bdag la dgongs// lha mchog bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// byams pa'i zhal bzang bdag la bstan du gsol//

zhes brjod/ dgu pa tshogs bsag pa ni/ hūm̐ */ bdag nyid khro rgyal skur gsal ba'i// snying gar a las nyi ma'i dal// de'i steng hūm̐ las rdo rje che// nag po rtse dgu rwa gdengs pa'i| |lte bar hūm̐ yig nag po 'bar// de las 'od zer rab 'phros pas// bla ma dkon mchog rig pa'i lha// rdo rje 'jigs byed la sogs pa// mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs gyur// chos dbyings 'og min phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas// skye med chos sku longs sku rdzogs pa'i sku// sprul sku chos nyid dge 'dun sras bcas la// lus ngag yid gsum dang bas phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya chen po// dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul 'jig rten bkang*// sku gsum lhun rdzogs sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// byang chub sems sogs kun la rgyas par 'bul// 'dod chags la sogs nyon mongs dbang gis ni// lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa ci bgyis pa// thams cad sku gsum rdo rje'i bde gshegs dang*| |byang chub spyan sngar ma lus bshags par bgyi// phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// byang chub sems dpa' dag dang 'gro ba yi// rgya chen rab zab bsod nams dge ba'i tshogs// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang*// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten bsam yas dpag med na// sku gsum rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ji snyed gcig /bzhugs shing mnyam bzhag 'gro 'dul de dag la// chos kyi 'khor lo bla med bskor bar bskul// dus gsum bde gshegs mya ngan 'da' bzhed pa// de dag kun la bdag gis thal sbyar te// 'gro ba'i don du bskal pa dpag med du// bzhugs shing thugs rjes don mdzad gsol ba 'debs// skye med ngang las ye shes skur ston cing*// thugs rje chen pos kun la khyab mdzad pa'i// dpa' bo bdud 'dul sangs rgyas thams cad la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// phyag 'tshal mchod dang sdig pa bshags la sogs// dge ba gzhan gyi de dag thams cad kun// bla med byang chub dam pa thob bya'i phyir// bdag gis yang dag yongs su bsngo bar bgyi//

zhes gsum dang*/ bla ma yi dam gshin rje'i gshed// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro srung mar bcas// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// sems can kun don bsgrub pa'i phyir// bdag gis badz+ra bhai ra ba// sgom dang bzlas par bya lags kyi// de yi dngos grub ma lus pa// 'bad med myur du bstsal du gsol| |de skad gsol btab lha bla mas// rjes su gnang ba legs bstsal nas// badz+ra muḥ tshogs zhing rang gnas gshegs par gyur// ces brjod cing bsgom mo/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ tshad med bzhi dang ting 'dzin gsum// rten dang zhing khams gsum dag dang*// brten pa gtso 'khor bskyed spyan drangs// dbang bskur rgyas gdab gnas gsum dang*// skye mched byin rlabs bzhugs phyag 'tshal// mchod bstod rdzogs rim mdun bskyed sgrub// 'dzab bzla rtags mthong dngos grub blang*// dang po tshad med bzhi ni/ hūm̐ */ mtha' yas sems can ma lus pa// sdig spong dge ba rnam par spyod// sems kyi rgyud bcings yongs su dag /sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras dang bral zhing*// bde ba'i rgyu 'bras phrad par ldan// de nyid mi 'bral rgyun bsten cing*// thams cad kun snyoms chos brgyad bral// gnyis pa ting 'dzin gsum ni/ hūm̐ */ gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos thams cad// bdag med spros bral ma bcos ngang*// rang bzhin rnam dag byang chub sems// snang stong 'od gsal stong pa nyid// de dag ma rtogs sems can rnams| |snying rje'i yul gyur de don phyir// rang rig dhīḥyig dmar ser ni// nyi ma ji bzhin nam mkhar gnas// gsum pa rten bskyed pa ni/ raṃ las nyi dkyil 'od 'bar steng*// hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje yi// lte bar hūm̐ 'od zhu ba las// rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba gur// phyi rol ye shes me chen 'bar// de nang dur khrod rngam pa'i zhing*// mi dang rta la sogs pa'i ro// rlon dang skam dang rul ba dang*// gsar rnying stod smad rangs pa dang*// rengs 'khum bub 'gyel langs dang rgyug

/lhu dum mgo dang phyed tshal dang*// keng rus brul dang tshal pa sogs// spungs dang bkram pa'i bar mtshams kun// khrag zhag chu ser rkang klad dang*// lha ba nang khrol skra sen dang*// stag gzig dom dred kaṃ ka dang*// bya glag rgod dang dur bya dang*// bya rog 'ug pa ce spyang tshogs| |ro la 'drad dang gshog pa dang*// thung zhing 'gyed dang longs spyod byed// ma gshin dregs pa sde brgyad dang*// snang srid pho mo klu rgyud kyis// bsdus pa'i 'byung po dpag med dang*| |'jig rten yi dwags srog zan tshogs// sha za khrag 'thung rus la 'cha'// ldag nyog lta dgod ngu dang rgod// cho nge khu 'debs brang rdung dang*// bshug glu len cing rkan sgra rdeb// gar byed 'khrab dang rgyug byed mchong*// sna tshogs cho 'phrul cir yang ston// gzhan yang phyogs skyong zhing skyong lha// klu dang mchod rten ri shing me// chu dang grub chen rnal 'byor sogs// bkod pa tshad las 'das pa'i dbus// thod pa'i gur khang yangs pa'i nang*// dmar ser bh+rūṃ yig yongs gyur pa// gnam lcags mtshon cha'i 'khor lo ni// phyogs mtshams brgyad dang steng 'og bcur// rab 'bar rtsibs ldan lte ba'i dbus// yaṃ las rlung dkyil sngon po ni// rdo rje rgya gram ba dan mtshan// de'i steng a las zla dkyil steng*// bzhi pa zhing khams gsum dag pa ni/ nam mkha'i dhīḥyig der bab pas// ral gri dhīḥs mtshan yongs gyur la// 'jam pa'i rdo rje gser gyi mdog /zhi tshul dar dang rin chen brgyan// ut+pal la gnas ral gri dang*// glegs bam 'dzin pa'i thugs ka ru// a las nyi dkyil dang bcas las// 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*// byang sems lha mo khro bor bcas// spyan drangs nyir thim ro gcig gyur// sku yi zhing khams dag pa'o// de las 'od 'phros phyogs kun tu// dpag tshad stong phrag 'bum khyab spros// sngags kyi byin rlabs kun bsdus te// thim pas nyi dkyil 'jam mgon bcas// 'od zhu hūm̐ nag 'od lnga 'bar// gsung gi zhing khams dag pa'o// de las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu yi// rgyal ba sras bcas zhi dang khro// phyag mtshan kun bsdus hūm̐ la thim// yongs gyur rdo rje nag po ni// rtse dgu rwa gdengs 'od lnga 'bar// lte bar nyi dbus hūm̐ nag brjid// 'od 'phros sangs rgyas zhing yang dag
/sems can ma lus yongs smin byas| |thugs kyi zhing khams dag pa'o//

lnga pa brten pa lha gtso bo bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ dang rdo rje las spros pa'i// rdo rje phra mo'i 'od zer gyis// sangs rgyas byang sems zhi khro'i lha// nam mkhar til gyi gang bu ltar// gang ba nyi shar gnas rnams kyis// 'gro kun smin sbyangs byang chub bkod// 'dus nas de dag thams cad kun// rdo rje hūm̐ bcas la thim zhing*// de dag yongs su gyur pa las| |bdag nyid rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal// shin tu mi bzad gshin rje'i gshed// rdo rje 'jigs byed sku ru gyur// rab tu khro zhing rngam pa'i gdong*// dus mtha'i me ltar rab tu 'bar// sku mdog mig sman ltar gnag cing*// zhal dgu phyag ni sum cu bzhi// zhabs ni bcu drug mtshan ma sgreng*// rtsa zhal khros pa ma he'i gdong*// rwa yi g.yas kyi zhal gsum ni/ sngo dang dmar po ser zhing khro// g.yon gsum dkar dud nag cing rngam// steng zhal rwa sprag zhal dmar po// srin po khros tshul khrag 'thung 'dzag /de steng 'jam dpal zhal ser nag /'dzum bcas yid tsam khros pa yi// gzhon nu zur phud lnga dang ldan// kun kyang spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs// sma ra smin ma glog ltar 'khyug /shin tu gtum rngam 'jigs tshul can// khro gnyer ljags 'dril sha khrag dang*// rkang klad khu zhag za zhing 'dzag /ha hā pho mo'i rngam sgra sgrog /phyag g.yas dang pos gri gug dang*// g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin// gnyis pa gnyis kyis glang lpags gyon// g.yas phyag bco brgyad steng nas rim// mtshon cha rtse gcig gtun shing gri// rdo rje rtse gcig sta re mdung*// mda' chen lcags kyu dbyug to dang*// kha ṭ+wāṃ 'khor lo rdo rje dang*// tho ba ral gri cang te'u bsnams// g.yon pa bco lnga steng rim bzhin// tshangs mgo phub rkang zhags pa dang*// lag pa rgyu ma gzhu thod tshal// ro ras gsal shing me thab 'bar// dril bu sdigs mdzub 'phan rlung ras// g.yas zhabs brgyad bskum mdun nas rim// mi dang ma he glang bong bu// rnga mong khyi lug wa mnan cing*// g.yon zhabs brgyad brkyang mdun rim bzhin// bya rgod 'ug pa bya rog dang*// ne tso khra dang khyung ri skegs// bzhad mnan ral pa dmar ser tshogs// gyen brdzes thod pa lnga lngas brgyan// gcer bu gsus khyim che la brjid// thod rlon khrag 'dzag do shal dang*// keng rus dur khrod chas brgyad 'chang*// ye shes 'od lnga'i me klong bsgyings// ha hā pheṃ gyi sgra bsgrags pas// tshangs pa brgya byin dbang phyug dang*// khyab 'jug gzhon nu za bar byed// khams gsum dregs pa gsol mdzad pa'i// 'jigs byed chen po'ang 'jigs par byed// 'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i| |lha rnams kun la sdigs mdzub bsgrengs// gshin rje 'jigs byed dregs pa 'joms// dur khrod gnas pa'i ma mo dang*// mkha' 'gro lha dang gnod sbyin dang*// ro langs gtum po rgod rnams dang*// dregs pa can kun bran du khol// dur khrod dkyil 'khor dbus na bzhugs//

drug pa 'khor spro ba ni/ bdag nyid khro rgyal 'jigs byed kyi// thugs nas rang rang mdog ldan hūm̐ yig bcu// rab 'bar phyogs bcu'i rtsibs nang spros pa las// rdo rje drag po smug nag 'khor lo shar// rdo rje snying po ser nag rdo rje lho// rdo rje rgyal po dmar nag be con nub// rdo rje gtum po ljang nag ral gri byang*// de bzhin shar lho lho nub nub byang dang*// byang shar rtsibs nang gnas pa'i khro bo ni// rdo rje rnon po dkar po kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin// rdo rje 'bar ba dmar ser me dpung thogs| |rdo rje 'bebs pa dmar smug gsal shing 'dzin// rdo rje stobs chen mthing skya dgra sta phyar// steng rtsibs khro rgyal rdo rje 'chang chen ni// mthing nag rdo rje gsor shing 'phen pa'i stangs| |'og gi rtsibs la rdo rje nag po ni// nag po rdo rje rgya gram 'gying ba 'phyar// bcu ga g.yon pa sdigs mdzub zhags pa 'dzin// spyan gsum mche gtsigs khro tshul brkyang bskum zhing*| |me dpung klong na mi bzad 'jigs tshul bzhugs// bdun pa spyan drang ba ni/ sha chen gu gul dang sbyar ba bsreg /rkang gling thod rnga sogs dur khrod kyi rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas te/ hūm̐ */ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// gdul bya rnams sbyang mthar bsgral phyir// ye shes rol par snang ba yi// khro rgyal gzugs skur bzhengs su gsol| |hūm̐ */ ye shes khro rgyal 'bar ba'i sku// thabs dang shes rab dkyil 'khor tshogs// thugs rje'i thabs kyis spyan 'dren na// dbyings nas sku skyod gnas 'dir gshegs// hūm̐ */ chos kyi sku las ma g.yos kyang*// rngam brjid khro bo'i rgyal por sprul// gshin rje gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir// ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra ba sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

e h+ye hi/ hūm̐ */ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ngor so sor snang*// don dam dbyings su ye nas gcig /gnyis su med par ro gcig bstim// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ brgyad pa dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni/ hūm̐ */ rang gi thugs las 'od 'phros pas// rigs lnga yab yum mdun spyan drangs// de bzhin gshegs pas bdag la ni// dbang bskur stsol zhes gsol btab pas// bum pas dbang bskur sgrib pa sbyangs// chu lhag gyen 'khyil mtshog ma'i steng*// rnam snang mdun du rdor sems dang*// rna ltag g.yas par rin chen 'byung*// ltag par dpag med rna ltag g.yon// don grub kyis brgyan dbang lha rnams// rang la thim pas smin par byas// dgu pa gnas gsum dang skye mched byin brlab pa ni/ hūm̐ */ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor bcas kyi// dpral mgrin snying ga oṃ āḥhūm̐// dkar dmar mthing las 'od 'phros pas// 'gro drug sgo gsum sgrib pa sbyangs// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i// dngos grub gsum bsdus gnas gsum thim// lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs// rgyan gyi rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs// dpral ba ltag pa mgrin par ni// pad+ma gar dbang snying gar ni// mi bskyod kyis mtshan mig rna ba| |sna dang lce dang lus yid la// k+ṣeṃ trāṃ hrīḥdz+rīṃ me dang ni// thaliṃ rnams las sa snying dang*// spyan ras gzigs dang rdo rje bsnams// byams pa sgrib sel kun bzang rnams// rang rang rgyan dang phyag mtshan rdzogs// chu zla bzhin du gsal bar gyur// oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ ma hā ā dar+sha dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ ma hā sa ma tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ ma hā pra ti pra we sha dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ ma hā kṛ ta a nu ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bcu pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ */ sangs rgyas khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed// ye shes rang snang dkyil 'khor lha// sgrib sbyong dngos grub stsol ba'i lha// gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra ba sa pa ri wā ra ā sa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ bcu gcig pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ */ skye med chos sku dag pa la// ye shes khro mchog rngam pa'i sku// gzugs sku rol pa'i dkyil 'khor la// sgo gsum dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra ba sa pa ri wā rā ya na ma ra ro mi/ bcu gnyis pa mchod ba ni/ hūm̐ */ ye shes khro rgyal dkyil 'khor la// mchod yon me tog spos mar me// lha bshos rol mo bcas pa 'bul// thugs rjes bzhes la dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra ba sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gan+dhe// nai wi d+ye/ shapad pū dza hoḥ hūm̐ */ snang srid kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim dang*// ro mchog reg 'jam sna tshogs pa// khro rgyal 'bar ba'i tshogs la 'bul// oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra ba sa pa ri wā ra rū pa/ shapad/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she pū dza hoḥ hūm̐ */ dgra bgegs dam sri rab bsgral ba'i// snang mdzad tshil chen bdug spos te// bkrag mdangs yid 'ong me tog la// drod dang tshil chen mar me nyid// dri chab de nyid shes bya ste// rak+ta de nyid snying gi khrag /gtor ma sha rus rkang tshil sogs// bdud rtsi khu ba la sogs lnga// dur khrod nang mchod chen po ste// rdo rje 'jigs byed tshogs la 'bul// oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra ba sa pa ri wā ra a nu rā ga pū dza pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ nyon mongs dug lnga rnam rtog tshogs// gzung 'dzin dam sri dgra gdon bgegs// mnyam nyid ngang du bsgral ba yi// mchod pa gshin rje'i gshed la 'bul// oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra ba sa pa ri wā ra ru tra ma ra ṇa pū dza pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

hūm̐ */ snang srid ye shes rang shar ba'i// phyag rgya dkyil 'khor bsam mi khyab// mdzad pa phrin las 'grub pa'i rtag /phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul| |oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra ba sa pa ri wā ra nṛ t+yai pū dza pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ mnyam nyid ngang las nā da'i sgra// zin dang ma zin ji snyed pa// gzhom du med pa snyan pa'i gdangs// drug skyes glu dbyangs mchod par 'bul// oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ hūm̐ */ bde bar gshegs so gshin rje'i gshed// rgyal ba rgya mtsho bsam mi khyab// srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' las 'das| |kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// stong go ro tsa na/ tsit+ta/ keṃ ni ri ti/ ba su ta/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa pū dza sa ma ya swā hā/ bcu gsum pa bstod pa ni/ sha chen gyi spos dang bcas te/ hūm̐ */ 'phags mchog khro rgyal rdo rje 'jigs byed ni// skye mched rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid las// 'gag med rang byung chen po'i sku bzhengs shig /bdud 'dul dpal chen phyag rgya 'dir ston cig /sku mdog mthing nag mi 'gyur drag por mdzad// dbu dgu gab pa mtshon cha nad dgu 'bebs// dbus zhal ma he'i gdong khros khrag 'thung ba// spyi gtsug khro 'jigs dmar po srin po'i zhal// steng zhal 'jam dpal zhal ser gtum khro 'jigs// rwa g.yas zhal gsum sngo dmar ser po khro// rwa g.yon zhal gsum dkar dang dud kha gnag /spyan gsum mche gtsigs sma ra ag tshom ser// smin ma khro gnyer glog stong 'od du 'khyug /g.yas zhal gsum nas hūm̐ sgra rngam bsgrags pas// stong gsum dregs pa ma lus bran du khol// g.yon zhal gsum nas phaṭa sgra rngam bsgrags pas// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs thal bar rlog par byed// dbus zhal gsum nas pheṃ gyi sgra bsgrags pas// dur khrod ma tshogs thams cad dbang du bsdus| |dbus zhal ma he khro gtum bzhad pa yis// stong gsum ma lus g.yo 'gul ldeg par byed// phyag rnams dang pos dang po gnyis/ gri gug thod khrag bsnams// phyag gnyis gnyis pa gnyis kyis/ glang po'i pags rlon 'dzin cing mnabs// gsum pa gnyis/ mtshon rtse gcig pa tshangs pa'i mgo// bzhi pa gnyis/ gtun shing rdeg cing go phub bsnams// lnga pa gnyis/ chu gri dang ni mi yi rkang*// drug pa gnyis/ rdo rje rtse gcig zhags pa bsnams// bdun pa gnyis/ sta re dang ni mi'i lag pa// brgyad pa gnyis/ mdung thung rdo rje'i zhags pa bsnams// dgu pa gnyis/ mda' chen dang ni rdo rje'i gzhu// bcu pa

gnyis/ lcags kyu dag dang thod tshal bsnams// bcu gcig gnyis/ dbyug to dang ni dur khrod ras// bcu gnyis gnyis/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang gsal shing bsnams// bcu gsum gnyis/ 'khor lo tho ba me dpung 'bar// bcu bzhi gnyis/ rdo rje kha gdangs dril bu 'khrol// bco lnga gnyis/ rdo rje'i tho ba sdig mdzub bsgrengs// bcu drug gnyis/ ral gri 'bar ba 'phan rtse gsum// bcu bdun gnyis/ cang te'u rlung bskyod ras bsnams pa// sna tshogs mtshon cha gdug pa kun 'dul zhing*// dgra bgegs ma lus myur du sgrol bar mdzod// bcu drug zhabs ni brkyang bskum tshul bzhugs pa// zhabs kyi dang pos mi dang bya rgod mnan// gnyis pa'i zhabs kyis ma he 'ug pa mnan// gsum pa'i zhabs kyis glang po bya rog mnan// bzhi pa'i zhabs kyis bong bu ne tso mnan// lnga pa'i zhabs kyis rnga mong bya khra mnan// drug pa'i zhabs kyis khyi dang khyung chen mnan// bdun pa'i zhabs kyis lug dang ri skegs mnan// brgyad pa'i zhabs kyis wa dang bzhad mnan pa// 'jig rten bya dang dud 'gro thams cad gdan du mdzad// pho mtshan gyen du bsgrengs pas 'jig rten gyi// bdud bzhi zil gnon mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud// gsang ba'i rdo rjes ma mo'i re 'dod skong*// gcer bu mi 'gyur dbyar gyi char sprin 'dra// 'jig rten lha dang gnod sbyin dregs pa can// mgo bcad thod rlon phreng bas do shal mdzad// thod pa skam po'i phreng bas dbu brgyan cing*// dur khrod keng rus mang po'i do shal mdzad// ye shes me dpung 'bar bas srid gsum sreg |rdo rje'i sku mchog khro gtum rngam pa yis// bdud dang mu stegs 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed// bdud kyi bdud sde bdud rnams sgrol mdzad pa// rngam sgra nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba yis| |'jig rten dregs pa pho mo zil gyis gnon// bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// shin tu mi bzad gtum rngam gar stabs bzhugs// tshangs pa brgya byin khyab 'jug dbang phyug che// khro bo'i gad rgyangs bsgrags pas snying khrag skyug

/ma mo mkha' 'gro bdud mo srin mo'i tshogs// dgyes pa'i gad mos dbang sdud bran du khol// dur khrod sha za srin po ro langs dang*// ce spyang stag dom kaṃ ka bya gcan tshogs// sha za ma lus pho nya sprul par 'gyed// kun kyang 'jigs pa'i nga ro ha hā sgrog /rngam pa'i rgyal po khrag 'thung gshin rje'i gshed// rang byung 'gyur med thams cad 'joms mdzad pa// rdo rje 'jigs byed sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// bstan pa bshig rnams thal ba'i rdul du rlogs//

zhes bstod/ yi dam gyi sku la sems ma yeng bar gsal snang yun ring du 'don/ de las skyo na/ e ma/ ye shes rang 'od me ri 'bar// mi mthun srung skyob rdo rje'i gur// rnam rtog dag pa dur khrod 'bar// ltas ngan 'joms pa thod pa'i mkhar// phyi snod rnam dag 'khor lo che// lte bar chos sku spros med zlum// rtsibs rnams ye shes rol par 'phro// bdud bzhi nyon mongs dug lnga gcod// kun 'grub chos kyi 'khor lo 'dis// bla med byang chub yang dag thob// sems kyi snang cha gshin rje'i gshed// stong pa ye shes gshis lugs nyid// gti mug rnam dag ma he'i zhal// zhe sdang dag pas mtshon cha bsnams// chags pa mi mnga' mtshan ma bsgrengs// 'jam dpal thugs kyi snying po las// sprul pa'i ye shes 'od zer shar// zhing bcu sgrol zhing rnam rtog sbyong*// rigs can sems dpa' chen po sogs// 'khor lo rgyal po yun du gnas// zhes pa dag pa dran par bya'o// bcu bzhi pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ni/ lha sku 'ja' tshon lta bu yi// lte bar hūm̐ yig 'od du 'bar// de 'og oṃ dmar 'od du zhu// ma he'i zhal gyi sna bug nas// srog rtsol thur sdig 'og rlung bsdam// rlung de yar log yi ge ni// gnyis la thim zhing slar yang rlung*// yar log ma he'i sna bug nas// dmar nag 'od du phyogs bcur 'phros// snang rten thams cad gsal bar byas// 'od zer tshur 'dus sna bug zhugs// lte ba'i yi ge gnyis la thim// yig gnyis gsal bar sems bzung ngo*// slar yang hūm̐ gi nā da la// sems bzung snang rten sna tshogs pa// 'od zer dmar po gcig tu 'bar// de bsdus snang ba phra rags kun// rang la bsdu zhing rang nyid kyang*// g.yas pa'i zhal gsum dag la thim// g.yas zhal gsum ni ma he yi// sna bug g.yas zhugs g.yon zhal gsum// sna bug g.yon zhugs sku thams cad// lte ba'i yi ge gnyis la thim// yi ge gnyis zhu thig le ni// dmar nag 'od zer 'bar bar gyur// de yang je phrar gyur nas kyang*// shin tu phra la sems bzung ba// ma yeng yid yul yun ring bsgom// slar yang chu nang rdo bskyur ba'i// rim pa 'phel ba ji bzhin du// thig le las mched lha yi sku// sngar bzhin skad cig rdzogs gsal gdab//

de dag rdzogs rim bsdus pa ste// rgyas par logs su bris ltar rtogs// bco lnga pa mdun bskyed gsal btab pa ni/ hūm̐ */ mtha' yas sems can ma lus pa'i// zhes tshad med bzhi bsgoms nas bzung*/ bstan pa bshig rnams thal ba'i rdul du rlogs// zhes bstod pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar la/ rang rig dhīḥyig dmar ser ni// zhes pa'i tshab tu/ de don phyir// bdag nyid lha yi thugs srog las// dhīḥyig dmar ser skar mda' ltar// ma he'i shangs nas rab 'phros pas// nyi ma ji bzhin nam mkha' zhes sbyar// gzhan yang bdag nyid dang rang nyid sogs la/ mdun du zhes bsgyur/ dbang lha rnams rang la thim pa zhes pa'i mal du/ de la thim pas smin par byas// zhes sbyar ro// bcu drug 'dzab bzla ba ni/ bdag mdun thugs kar nyi steng du// ya yig nag po khog stong gi// nang du rdo rje nag po ni/ rtse dgu rwa gdengs lte ba'i dbus// nyi dkyil hūm̐ nag 'od lnga 'bar// de mthar drug pa gnyis dang bdun// bcu pa bcu drug so gnyis pa'i// sngags kyis bskor zhing de bzlas pas// bdag mdun sngags phreng rab spros pa// ma he'i zhal thon mdun bskyed kyi// ma he'i zhal zhugs thugs kar thim// dngos grub mthu bsdus bdag la bstim// mdun bskyed zhal nas sngags phreng byung*// bdag nyid ma he'i zhal du zhugs// mdun thugs sngags las sngags 'od 'phros// mdun bskyed lha yi thugs kar zhugs// thugs dam rgyud bskul sgo gsum gyi// dngos grub bsdus nas bdag la bstsal// mdun gyi 'jigs byed thugs ka nas// 'od 'phros bdag gi thugs kar bstims// bdag gi lus ngag yid sgrib sbyangs// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub 'dus// bdag dang khro rgyal gnyis med gyur// de ltar 'khor lo ltar bsgom mo// oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ kā la rū pa hūm̐/ zhes drug pa gnyis dang*/

oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bdun pa/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭī bi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bcu pa/ ya ma me dak+ṣe/ rā tsa sa do| ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya tsa ni/ zhes bcu bdun pa/ ya ma rā tsa sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya/ ya k+ṣe ya tsa ni ra ma ya/ zhes so gnyis pa bzla'o// grangs tshad ni rgyud las/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa bye ba chig 'bum gsum/ zhes pas/ bye ba gcig dang 'bum phrag gsum bzla ba yin/ dus ni rgyud las/ dus ni rlung nag 'brug sgra 'tshub ma g.yos/ zhes dang*/ rtags ni rgyud las/ mtshan ma phyi nang gsang ba gsum du 'byung*// zhes gsungs pas/ 'og tu 'chad pa ltar ro// bdag mdun lhan cig tu bsnyen pa byed pa ni lugs 'di nyid kyi khyad chos so// 'khor gyi bsnyen pa ni/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drag 'khor bas// dam sri dgra bgegs tshar bcad cing*// thog ser me lce rab 'phros pas// log 'dren thal ba'i rdul du rlog /nyon mongs dug lnga bdud bzhi bcom// khro bcu'i zhal nas sngags sgra sgrog /byad stems ngan sbyor phyir la bzlog /kho rang gshed du bab par gyur// ces dmigs nas/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐/ badz+ra bhai ra ba ma hā kro dha rā dzā ya/ hrīḥṣ+ṭī bi kṛ tā na na/ ya ma ye dak+ṣe rā tsa sa do ru ṇa yo ni ra ya tsa ni/ badz+ra u gra ya/ badz+ra garbaha/ badz+ra rā dza/ badz+ra tsan+to/ badz+ra kharga/ badz+ra dz+wa la/ badz+ra baṣ+ḍo/ badz+ra sa mi/ badz+ra kā lī/ badz+ra dha ro/ badz+ra man+d+ra pra ye ga ma ma sarba bigh+nān da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ s+t+waṃ bha ya/ s+t+waṃ bha ya/ nā sha ya/ nā sha ya/ ha na ha na/ tsakra tsakra tsarti/ tsakra warti/ pra t+yaṃ gi ra/ pra t+yaṃ gi ra/ mā ra ya/ mā ra ya/ badz+ra bhai ra ba ma hā kro dha rā dzā ya/ bi dh+waṃ sa ya/ bi dh+waṃ sa ya/ bi tsur+ṇa ya/ bi tsur+ṇa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas te/ khro bcu sngags dang bcas pa ni rgyud 'di nyid kyi 'jigs byed gsungs pa'i phyir zlog 'khor lo'i skabs yin pas na/

rang bzhin bsnyen sgrub kyi tshe thun gyi mgo mjug tu nyer gcig yan ci nus tsam bzlas pas chog la/ rmi lam mngon sum gang la'ang ngan pa'i rtags mthong na khro bcu'i dmigs pa gsal bas sngags ci mang bzlas na zlog pa kun gyi mchog tu 'dug go// bcu bdun pa rtags ni/ de ltar mi tshig gis bar ma chod par rab kyis sngags drug ka bye ba re dang*/ 'bum phrag gsum re bzla/ de ma grub na sngags drug po gang rung zhig la bye ba gcig dang 'bum gsum thems par bzlas rjes/ de'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg kyang bya/ sngags gzhan rnams ji tsam 'grub pa bzlas pas kyang rung ste/ rgyud las/ bsnyen pa gang bskyal sngags kyi sbyin sreg bya// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'on kyang grangs dus kyi bsnyen pa las rtags kyi bsnyen pa gtso che bas/ rtags ma byung bar du nyin mtshan thun drug gam/ bzhir bcad de mi tshig gis bar ma chod cing sems ma yengs par rtse gcig tu bzla/ thun dang por skyabs sems nas bzlas pa'i bar cho ga rdzogs par bya/ thun phyi ma rnams kyi 'gor dngos gzhi tshad med bzhi nas bzlas pa'i bar bya/ thun mtha' rnams su 'og nas 'byung ba ltar thun gtor re 'bul lo// rtags ni rgyud las/ ye shes las kyi lha grub pa'i// rtags dang nyams kyi rim pa ni// dbang thob dam tshig mnyam bzhag sngags bzlas pas// rab kyis lha yi sku nyid ni// rdo rje 'jigs byed dngos su mthong*// ci 'dod gsung zhing byin gyis brlabs// de la rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos// 'jigs par mi bya ci 'dod slong*// gang 'dod las rnams 'grub par 'gyur// 'bring gis gzugs brnyan 'dzum dang bzhad// lung ston rmi lam mthong bar 'gyur// tha ma zhub can mon pa dang*// mi nag bya nag mchod rten sngo// rlung nag 'tshub dang 'brug sgra sgrog /sna tshogs mtshan ma mthong bar 'gyur// gzhan yang go chas lus brgyan dang*// lag na mtshon cha 'bar ba dang*// seng ge la sogs gcan gzan tshogs// bdag gi drung 'khor pho nyar byed// sems gsal yid brtan sran tshugs shing*// snang srid phyag rgyar 'bar la sogs// sna tshogs mtshan ma 'byung bar 'gyur// de dus dngos grub blang ba ni// zhes gsungs pas/

rtags rab 'bring tha ma gang yin yang lan gsum yan chad mthong ba'i gdeng thob pa zhig nges par dgos so// bco brgyad pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga dang snying po lnga dang bsres pa'i zla khrom dang*/ zla rgyas dang*/ tshe gal mthun gsum/ gzhan yang bza' btung longs spyod sna tshogs bsags pa'i phud rnams lha la 'bul/ de rjes dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes las kyi lha rnams kyi// snying pos bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs// bdag gi spyi mgrin snying ga ru// oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing las// 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal dang sras// khro bo khro mo thams cad dang*// rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po yi// gnas gsum sku la thim gyur pas// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul| |sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// 'od zer rnam gsum tshur 'dus te// bdag gi lus gnas gsum du thim// lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyangs// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob// spyi bo'i oṃ dkar 'od zhu bas// khro bo dkar po zla gdan bzhugs// thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dkar// de dbus snying po oṃ dkar las// mgrin pa'i āḥdamar 'od zhu bas// khro bo dmar po pad ldan bzhugs// thugs kar pad dmar 'dab brgyad dbus// snying gar āḥdamar 'od du 'bar// snying ga'i hūm̐ mthing 'od zhu ba// khro bo mthing nag nyi dkyil bzhugs// thugs kar rdo rje mthing nag rwa// gdengs pa'i lte bar hūm̐ nag 'bar// rnal 'byor lus ngag yid gsum dang*// gnyis med mnyam pa chen por gyur// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// yang dag nges pa thob gyur nas// gang bcol las rnams thog med 'grub// ces bsam bzhin/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ ma hā kro dha badz+ra bhai ra ba kā ya badz+ra sid+dhi oṃ/ oṃ kā la rū pa āḥm hā kro dha badz+ra bhai ra ba wāka badz+ra sid+dhi āḥ

oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭī bi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ ma hā kro dha badz+ra bhai ra ba tsit+ta badz+ra sid+dhi hūm̐ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes bzlas dbang blangs dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams longs spyod do// dngos grub kyi cho ga 'di ni bsnyen sgrub kyi tshe ma gtogs rgyun du dang las sbyor sgrub pa sogs kyi skabs mi dgos so// gsum pa rjes ni/ tshogs rdzas byin brlabs dang po 'bul// bar pas bskang bshags tha ma ni// gdab las bya zhing tshogs la rol// lhag ma btang zhing thun gtor 'phang*// gtor mnan bzod gsol gshegs bsdu dang*// smon lam shis brjod bya rnams so// dang po tshogs rdzas bza' btung g.yos sbyar rnams/ zhing chen nam gcan gzan lpags pa'i steng du bkram par/ me rlung chus sbyangs shing*/ hūm̐ */ rang nyid lha yi thugs srog las// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ las me rlung chu// spros pas tshogs kyi dri ma rnams// bsregs gtor bkrus shing dag par byas// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ ga ṇa tsakra bi shud+dhe hoḥ slar yang bdag gi thugs ka nas// oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang ha hoḥhrīḥ dkar dmar mthing spros tshogs rdzas la// thim pas snod bcud bcas pa rnams// mtshan ldan thod par sha lnga dang*| |bdud rtsi lnga ldan ye shes kyi// bza' btung 'dod yon rdzas su gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ tshogs phud dang po gtor mar 'bul/ sman raka bsgron la/ hūm̐ */ chos dbyings drag po'i zhing khams nas// bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed che// rgyal ba rgya mtsho zhi khro dang*// mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs kyis bskor// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs kyi rdzas// bza' btung longs spyod sna tshogs pa// 'bul lo bzhes shig kha raṃ khā hi// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ni// mchog thun 'bras bu bdag la stsol// oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra ba sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra i maṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/

bar pa bsgron la bskang bshags bya ste/ hūm̐ */ snang srid rtsi bcud zhal zas tshogs// sha khrag sna tshogs 'bru bcud chang*// ro mchog brgya ldan bza' btung tshogs// 'dod yon lha mos mdzes par brgyan// stabs byed gar bsgyur glu dbyangs len// snang srid rnam dag mchod pa 'dis// khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje'i gshed// rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor bcas kyi// thugs dam skong phyir 'bul lags na// bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra ba sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha pra tīts+tsha sa ma ya hūm̐/ hoḥ bdag cag ma rig dbang gyur cing*// mi shes blo dang rab ldan pas// nyams chag 'khrul bas nongs bgyis kun// khro rgyal 'khor bcas spyan snga ru| |gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags// tshangs par bzhes la dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra ba sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ sogs yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ tshogs tha ma la zan ling ong skyu sha khrag gis sbags pa thod ngan du mgo rang la bstan te bzhag pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du e las brub khung zangs lcags khro chu las grub pa'i khang sgrom zur gsum bang rim dgu ldan kha khyer yangs shing gting zab pa/ dug gsum me rlung khrag mtsho 'bar g.yo 'khrugs pa/ 'chi bdag /shan pa/ yi dwags/ sha za sde brgyad du ma 'du zhing*/ dgra bgegs gsod gcod kyi las rgyun mi 'chad du byed pa'i drag po'i zhing khams/ 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba/ mthong ba thos pa tsam gyis kyang 'dar zhing sngangs bar byed pa/ de'i nang du nṛ tri las dgra bgegs gnod byed zhing bcu bsgral ba'i 'os su gyur pa dmigs bya de dang de dag thams cad/ nyams chung ba/ rid pa rkang lag lcags su bcug nas mgo rang la phyogs pa gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i dus kyi zhags pa nag pos mgrin pa bcings pa/ bu ga dgu nas rnag khrag 'dzag cing kha nas 'o dod 'bod pa/

srung skyob kyi lha dang bral ba zhig tu gyur/ bden stobs gsum sogs brjod cing*/ hūm̐ */ nga ni rdo rje 'jigs byed che// khros pa'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas// rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas// sgo med lcags mkhar nag po nas// 'chi bdag gshin rje nag po ni// gcer bu mi bzad 'jigs rngam can| |ral gri sdigs mdzub ma he zhon// skra 'dzing kha gdangs mche ba gtsigs// mig gsum sma ra khro gnyer can// skad cig gis bkug de nyid la// ma he'i gdong gis 'di skad ces// dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed pa'i// bla mar smod cing bdag la sdang*// byad ma rbod gtong bdag la sdang*// dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs gar gnas kyang*// khug cig rgyob cig sod cig ces| |bsgos pas de yi pho nya'i tshogs// lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril// rnam pa sna tshogs sha zan tshogs// bya rgod bya rog 'ug pa dang*// khyung khra kaṃ ka ne'u le dang*// sha za gcan gzan stag dom bcas// wa khyi ce spyang gdug pa spros// dmigs bya bkug cing gzugs la bstims// lha dang phral nas bdud dang sprod// oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭī= dgra bgegs aṃ ku sha dzaḥ pā sha hūm̐/ s+pho ṭa baṃ/ ā we sha ya hoḥ

zhes pho nya bkug cing gzugs la bstim/ hūm̐ */ nga ni khro rgyal 'jigs chen po// thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya ni// 'chi bdag dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// phur thun rdo rje'i mtshon cha thogs// me lce thog ser tsha tsha 'phro// nad kyi rkyal pa sha za'i tshogs// nam mkha' gang bas dgra la btibs// sha za khrag 'thung rus pa 'cha'| |ri rab kyis mnan sa 'og nub// rgya mtsho'i gting bcug rba la g.yeng*// me dpung gis bsregs thal bar brlag /las kyi rlung nag 'tshub mas khyer// srog gi rjes shul med par byas// oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭī= dgra bgegs gnod byed s+t+waṃ bha ya staṃ bha ya mā ra ya mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ mā ra ya dzaḥ mā ra ya phaṭa/ mā ra ya nan/ zhes thun brab/ phur bu gdab/ slar mi bsad pa'i mtshon chas gtub cing*/ hūm̐ */ nga ni sangs rgyas kun gyi sku// nga ni khro bo kun gyi rje// nga ni dus gsum mngon pa'i lha// nga ni srid gsum snying rje'i bdag /nga ni khams gsum sgrol ba'i ging*// nga ni gshin rje kun gyi gshed// nga ni ma mo mkha' 'gro'i yab// nga ni rang byung rdo rje'i sku// nga ni gdul dka' 'dul ba'i mchog /nga ni tshe srog kun gyi bdag /khams gsum srog la rang dbang bsgyur| |bstan pa gnyan po 'jig byed pa'i// log lta dgra bgegs thams cad kun// byang chub sems su bsgral byas te// sha zas rus 'cha' khrag 'thung ngo*// rdo rje 'jigs byed khros pa yi| |gnas las 'od 'phros gzas pa po'i// gnas bzhir thim pas 'thom pa bzhi// rang rang gnas nas bslangs pa la// ma he'i gdong gis bka' bsgos pas// klad pa'i rgya bshig rtsa bcad de// mgo 'khor klad khrag 'khrugs shing spyos// mgrin rtsa kha lkug ngag rgyun bcad// lto ba yid dkrug srid rtsa bcad// snying srog rtsa bcad sha khrag tshogs// bcad cing zos te shul med bsad// bdud bzhi rang gnad nang nas bskul// bslang zhing gshed phab rdul du rlog

/oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañja hūm̐ phaṭa/ ro tsa na ma ra ta ka pra ma ni thibs rbad/ hri te ni pa pa tsa ha na rak+ta tsa ra ni shag rbad/ pi ra thuṃ ril ru thuṃ murdza ni hur rbad/ tsit+ta tshal pa ni mā ra ya ku ru ni rbad/ ces bsgral la/ ling ro dang tshogs kyi sha zan dum zhig sbrags pa gtor mar bsgron zhing sman raka bran la/ hūm̐ */ rang sems ma rig 'khrul pa'i blos// nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa'i dgra// bsad bya gsod byed gsod pa'i thabs// 'khor gsum mi dmigs ka nas dag |kun rdzob sgyu ma'i rnam rol du// bstan pa 'jig cing slob dpon smod// bdag la sdang ba'i dgra dang bgegs// rdzas sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis// bsgral ba'i phung po ma lus pa| |dpal chen 'jigs byed tshogs la 'bul// gti mug sha la chems chems zo// 'dod chags khrag la lcib lcib 'thungs// zhe sdang rus la khrum khrum mur// klad pa hab thob sbar gyis rol| |srog rtsa don snod rngams shing 'jib// phung khams skye mched tshogs su rol// ga ṇa rak+ta a mṛ ta// dgyes par rol la tshim par mdzod// gzas pa'i sdig sgrib kun byang nas// rnam shes bde chen gnas su drongs// oṃ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra a mu kaṃ sha trūṃ ma ra ṇa maṃ sa/ rak+ta/ keṃ ni ri ti/ tsit+ta/ tsak+ṣuḥ dzi hwa/ kar+ṇa ka/ nā saṃ/ go ro tsa na/ ba su ta/ bo dhi tsit+ta/ srog ādz+nyā/ ga ṇa tsakra/ pañca a mṛ ta/ ru dhī ra kha kha khā hi khā hi// zhes bstab/ skabs 'dir drag po'i las kyi sgrub pa/ drag po'i sbyor ba/ bsad pa'i rab tu sbyor ba/ dbang du bsdu ba/ dgug pa/ thams cad rgyas pa/ zhi ba/ 'byed pa/ reng ba/ bskrad pa/ rab tu sbyor ba'i man ngag 'khrul 'khor/ gnad dgu/ drag sngags/ man ngag gi gnad bdun/ man ngag gi rim pa/ sbyor ba sna tshogs pa/ rten 'brel yid bzhin/ log non drag po la sogs pa'i las rab 'byams sbyin sreg dang 'khrul 'khor/

rdzas sngags kyi sgrub pa ji snyed cig gsungs pa rnams gang byed kyang rgyud don ltar ma 'khrul bar skabs 'dir byed dgos pa yin no// lnga pa ni tshogs rnams slob dpon nas rim par drangs shing*/ dpon slob kun gyis/ a la la hoḥ ma hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod pas bag med spyod pa spangs te lha'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang nas longs spyod do// drug pa ni dam tshig gcig pa kho na'i lhag ma bsdus la cha gsum du byas la rdo rje slob dpon gyis chang gi kha phru btab par/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ hūm̐ */ dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyu// dpal chen 'jigs byed phud kyi bdag /bar du tshogs la mi rol rgyu// rnal 'byor mched lcam tshogs kyi bdag /tha mar lhag ma mi btang rgyu// rdo rje pho nya lhag la dbang*// mnyam gsum gcig tu mi bsre rgyu// chos kun gdod nas ngo bo gcig / ces tha ma gnyis dbus su dril// dpal 'bar btsugs sman raka bran la/ hūm̐ */ dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi// bka' nyan tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag /rdo rje phra men pho nya'i tshogs// ma gshin mkha' 'gro ging dang bdud// sha za yi dwags sde brgyad tshogs// 'byung po bye ba phrag brgyar bcas// stong gsum bskor zhing rlung ltar rgyug /rdo rje'i rkang stabs lag pa'i gar// sna tshogs cho 'phrul ci yang ston| |glu bro mchong rgyug 'phur lding dang*/ glu dang bshug pa khus 'debs shing*// rgyob sod sgra dang brda skad sgyur// rnal 'byor nyams gyi drod nyul zhing*// dkyil 'khor sgrub khang steng dang 'og |phyogs mtshams rgyu zhing skal ldan la// sna tshogs cho 'phrul ci yang ston// dngos grub byin 'bebs stongs grogs byed// skal med nyams pa'i tshe srog 'phrog /sha khrag tshogs su rngams zas byed// las la grub pa'i pho nya rnams// dpal chen 'jigs byed bka' byung gi// 'bod do da lta 'dir gshegs la// bka' yi pha 'bab bza' btung rnams// khyer zhig zo zhig da rol la// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭā pa ti sarba bhuñja tha pī ba tha kha kha khā hi khā hi/
